approval_required_for: Any architecture, pipeline, memory-layout, data-order, or major template change beyond the bounded board manifest/compile-authority repair.
Any DUT RTL repair to operator leaves or the connected single-transformer-layer kernel before a current replay names a qualifying hash-bound contradiction.

Any change to checkpoint, deterministic stimulus, target-model reference execution, expected-output artifact, numeric tolerance, comparison policy, semantic testbench contract, or complete-scope Transformer-block weight requirements.
Any replacement, simplification, or source-hash change to the exact user-supplied sample-project AXI/DDR wrapper or simulation source closure.
Any guessed simulator executable, Vivado target, board path, module name, or runtime ABI binding when the supplied evidence is ambiguous.
Any lower-layer backtrack or certificate invalidation not backed by a current direct core start/ingress/egress trace, named causal boundary, current lower-certificate hash, and SACG-approved request.

consumes: exact selected sample-project wrapper and simulation source closure
current Vivado export facts and tool-profile authorization records
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep case_axi_ddr_interface and all downstream board gates blocked. Do not substitute a simplified wrapper, guess a simulator executable or Vivado target, modify golden outputs, or patch lower-layer RTL. Emit the exact unbound field and retain the active contamination barriers.
produces: repaired verification/board_simulation/board_simulation_manifest.json with a new artifact hash
executable_actions.rationale: The earliest executed current-layer failure is a manifest and canonical VCS authority-binding failure, not a proven DUT root cause. Repair only the existing agent-created board integration manifest/compile-plan artifacts so the exact user wrapper, source closure, compute-slot ABI, timing contract, Vivado export facts, and authorized simulator executable are cryptographically and procedurally bound. The source identity document and all immutable verification inputs must remain unchanged.

consumes: verification/board_interface/board_source_identity.json and its immutable source closure hash
exact Vivado export facts, compute-slot ABI, timing contract, and authorized tool profile
current SACG/CCTG causal slice and repair boundary
executable_actions.on_failure: Stop before VCS functional replay. Route the first failed authority or AXI/DDR checker to a bounded board-integration repair; do not classify the failure as connected-kernel or leaf-module incorrectness.
executable_actions.rationale: Validate the repaired authority binding before requesting functional acceptance. This is the required current board layer and must use the exact user-supplied sample wrapper and cited real Vivado evidence; a previously passing board identity result is not sufficient if the current simulation manifest remains unbound.

executable_actions.on_failure: Keep the board layer needs_repair. If replay is ambiguous, request another bounded current-layer trace rather than patching a downstream output module. If and only if the produced evidence explicitly names a current hash-bound contradiction to a lower certificate, create a SACG-approved targeted lower-layer backtrack request; do not silently reopen or rerun lower layers.
executable_actions.rationale: Lower layers have passed and must remain closed. Once current board authority is valid, rerun the same immutable checkpoint and deterministic stimulus through the exact board wrapper with boundary tracing. The replay must distinguish independent AXI/prefetch progress from output-frontier progress and must produce direct core start, ingress, egress, named causal-boundary, and current lower-certificate bindings. A missing output alone is not permission to reopen the connected kernel.

consumes: immutable numeric comparison policy and tolerance
exact user-supplied wrapper and simulation source hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: Route the earliest failed current-layer gate to Stage8 repair with its real-tool report and CCTG boundary. Treat not_run gates as evidence gaps, not passes. Do not loosen tolerance, regenerate expected outputs from RTL, omit weight layers, expand DUT scope into model-tail operations, or promote to backend/board runtime.
executable_actions.rationale: Only after exact identity, canonical VCS authority, and the current board boundary replay are valid may the remaining board closure gates execute. Preserve the exact checkpoint, input, target-model reference, numeric tolerance, semantic testbench hash, source closure, and complete Transformer-block weight scope. Expected outputs must remain from target-model inference, and every required bound weight must be proven consumed by executed loader evidence before numeric acceptance.

consumes: all current reports from repair_step.01 through repair_step.04
artifact.stage8.repair_plan as a superseded planning artifact
complete target-model reference and numeric comparison report
current SACG/CCTG causal slice and boundary contradiction reconciliation
sacg_memory_truth current retry and contamination set
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep status needs_repair and preserve all active trust barriers and open retry requests. Do not promote any board artifact to backend synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime ABI, or board runtime; return the earliest failed checker to the same current-layer repair loop.
executable_actions.rationale: The six open same-scope retry requests and active contamination barriers must remain enforced until the refined current-stage contract is backed by passing real-tool evidence. On complete success, return the current artifacts to Stage7 for an authoritative fail-closed decision; on any failure, keep rejected artifacts diagnostic-only and retain the retry barriers.

observations: The case adapter is ready for qwen2_hf_case, but readiness does not override the failed board verification gates.

Operator leaves and the connected single-transformer-layer kernel have live hash-validated pass evidence. The single-layer certificate explicitly does not claim board readiness, and hierarchical_learning_context marks lower-layer certificate continuity as reusable.

The board wrapper identity itself is marked pass and is bound to the exact user sample wrapper, selected simulation source closure, compute-slot ABI, timing contract, and Vivado facts. The earliest current failed checker is instead the board simulation manifest/canonical VCS plan: source_identity_sha256 is not bound, compile authority and authority_refs do not bind exact Vivado export facts, and ordered simulator executables are not authorized.

The supplied board trace accepted all 1792 current-layer ingress beats while the ready output frontier accepted zero beats; core egress was ready but never valid, and final writeback remained at zero of 896 beats. Independent AXI reads, prefetch progress, and runtime-load completion are supporting progress only and do not prove output or lifecycle-frontier progress.

The simulation ended through framework adaptive semantic-stall handling with exit code 86. No native zero-time livelock, simulator crash, fixed cycle timeout, or fixed wall-clock timeout was proven. This is not sufficient evidence to select a DUT RTL root cause.

The board_to_lower_layer_contradiction_evidence status is insufficient and reports no explicit lower-layer contradiction. The current output-frontier symptom therefore cannot reopen the connected kernel or leaf modules. A current replay must first correlate core start, ingress, egress, the named causal boundary, and the current lower certificate hashes.

Dynamic runtime-loader acceptance failed for all 24 layers: the existing loader results do not bind the runtime contracts, do not prove exact address/data coverage, and do not prove load completion before kernel start. Existing on-disk files and the binding manifest do not by themselves prove complete runtime consumption.

The target-model expected-output source is target_model_inference and consumed tensor hashes are present in the DUT binding manifest, but the board numeric comparison was not run. No functional, numeric, data-order, AXI, DDR, liveness, complete-weight-consumption, or semantic board pass may be claimed.
The conditional specialist router returned no_split; no specialist review was triggered. This does not replace deterministic checker evidence.

The authoritative SACG truth contains open retry_request.0136, .0140, .0141, .0142, .0143, and .0144 plus active contamination barriers for rejected Stage7 and Stage8 artifacts. These are current same-scope blockers until the refined repair artifacts and the subsequent Stage7 rerun pass.
proposed_actions: Repair the existing board simulation manifest and canonical VCS compile plan as a verification-capability artifact, binding unchanged exact wrapper/source hashes, current Vivado export facts, compute-slot ABI, timing contract, and authorized executables; do not alter DUT RTL, golden data, checkpoint, input, or numeric policy.
Rerun exact board identity and AXI/DDR interface validation. If identity or command authority remains unbound, stop before simulation and retain all SACG trust barriers.

After the manifest gate passes, run a bounded current-layer exact-board VCS replay with boundary monitors and the CCTG analyzer. Reconcile the output/lifecycle frontier and determine whether a qualifying hash-bound lower-layer contradiction exists; do not schedule lower-layer replay merely because output is absent.

If and only if the current board replay is identity-valid, execute the dependency-gated multilayer functional, deadlock, AXI protocol, DDR round-trip, data-order, numeric, runtime-loader, and board semantic evidence checks using the immutable reference artifacts.

Return the resulting evidence to Stage7 and reconcile the six open retries and active trust barriers only after all current checks pass; otherwise preserve needs_repair and route the earliest failed current-layer checker back to this bounded repair loop.
risks: Repeated historical repairs are contamination risks; the prior repair execution feedback is historical-only with zero reusable current-layer records.

Changing the exact wrapper, simulation source closure, compute-slot ABI, board identity, Vivado facts, simulator executable, or tool path without cited evidence would create a new identity failure and requires approval.

Changing checkpoint, stimulus, expected output, tolerance, numeric comparison policy, semantic testbench contract, or Transformer-block weight scope would invalidate the repair loop and requires approval.

The current board symptom may originate in wrapper lifecycle, runtime scheduling, data order, an interconnect boundary, or the connected kernel; no code root is authorized until current replay localizes the earliest causal owner.
A manifest repair that merely points at files on disk without complete executed loader records and complete-scope tensor hashes would not establish DUT weight consumption.
A missing semantic evidence report is a verification-capability blocker, not evidence that the accelerator is numerically incorrect.
Promotion to backend synthesis, implementation, bitstream generation, runtime-ABI release, or board runtime remains prohibited until every required current-layer gate passes with real-tool evidence.

constraints: Use the exact user-supplied wrapper and simulation source closure; do not substitute a simplified AXI/DDR wrapper.
Bind the simulation manifest and every ordered command to the current board identity, exact Vivado export facts, compute-slot ABI, and authorized tool profile.
Treat the supplied output-frontier stall as localization evidence, not as a preselected RTL root cause or a lower-layer reopening decision.
Preserve the validated operator-leaf and single-layer certificates unless a current hash-bound trace explicitly contradicts a named invariant.
Keep checkpoint, deterministic input provenance, target-model expected output, testbench contract, numeric policy, tolerances, and all source hashes immutable.
Require complete-scope Transformer-block weight consumption evidence; exclude embedding, tokenization, final norm, LM head, logits, and sampling from the DUT boundary.
Use target-model inference for expected outputs; never derive expected data from RTL output or random generation.
Active scoped SACG blockers include six open retry requests and seventeen active contamination barriers; rejected or historical artifacts remain diagnostic only until current checks pass.

output.summary: Keep the board_axi_ddr_wrapped_system closure fail-closed. Apply only a bounded verification-capability repair to bind the existing exact sample-project wrapper, current board identity, exact Vivado export facts, canonical VCS compile plan, and authorized simulator executables. Then rerun the current board layer with boundary tracing before considering any lower-layer action. Do not reopen the certified operator leaves or connected single-transformer-layer kernel, because the supplied board_to_lower_layer_contradiction_evidence is insufficient and the output-frontier symptom alone is not a qualifying lower-layer contradiction.
